citation.title: Complications of 3D printed dentures: A systematic review
citation.authors: Kathleen Smets, Stefan Vandeweghe, Lucas Ongenae, Rani D'haese

s_design.anchor: Systematic review (no meta-analysis) of 6 RCTs and 5 non-randomized clinical studies (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing)
s_design.evidence_quote: Complications of 3D printed dentures: A systematic review

domains.note: Methods read (PRISMA/PICO statement, eligibility, search, screening, data extraction, quality appraisal) together with the abstract, Results, Discussion/limitations and declarations. There is no protocol, no PROSPERO or other registration and no registration number anywhere in the text. Wording searched: protocol registered, PROSPERO, registration, a priori.

domains.evidence_quote: MEDLINE, Embase, and Google scholar databases,
domains.note: Two bibliographic databases were searched: PubMed/MEDLINE and Embase. Google Scholar is listed in addition. The full search strings are given in Table 1, and the reference lists of included articles were hand-searched. This meets the 3b-i threshold of at least 2 databases.

domains.evidence_quote: The search strategy yielded a total of 63 articles.
domains.note: The 4 excluded full texts are not identified by citation, so this is not low. The review does report both (a) a screening account with counts (63 to 55 screened to 15 assessed to 11 included, plus the Figure 1 flow diagram) and (b) explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria in Methods. Under 3b-iii that is some_concerns.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: Embase databases. The risk of bias in each study was assessed by using the Cochrane risk of bias
domains.note: RCTs were appraised with RoB 2 (Table 3) and non-randomized studies with the Newcastle-Ottawa scale (Table 4).

domains.evidence_quote: methods, statistical analysis was not possible.
domains.note: No meta-analysis was performed. The decision not to pool is stated and justified by the heterogeneity of populations and data collection methods. Nothing was combined inappropriately.

Methods, Results, Discussion and limitations paragraph were read. There is no assessment or discussion of publication bias or small-study effects. Wording searched: publication bias, funnel plot, small-study, Egger, reporting bias. None was found.

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement / manufacturer funding without independent-analysis statement
penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests
penalties.note: A competing-interests declaration is present. No commercial funder is named.

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: Not applicable: the paper is a systematic review, not an RCT.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.evidence_quote: limited study protocol time and washout times.
penalties.note: The review's own limitations name the limited study protocol time of the included studies. It nevertheless draws conclusions on remakes, repairs and follow-up visits, outcomes that need longer observation. Scaled: 3 × 100 ÷ 100 = 3.

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۲۷ از ۱۰۰ است و در باند D (شواهد ضعیف) برای سؤال THERAPY قرار می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مقاله یک systematic review روی شش RCT و پنج مطالعه‌ی غیرتصادفی است. نبودِ protocol ثبت‌شده و نبودِ ارزیابی publication bias امتیاز آن را پایین آورده است. نتایج کیفی و در بیشتر پیامدها متناقض‌اند و meta-analysis انجام نشده است. این نتایج برتری یکی از دو روش را نشان نمی‌دهد.

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of non-randomized studies (4 retrospective, 1 prospective) (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing)
s_design.evidence_quote: Results: Four retrospective studies and one prospective study, including 184 patients,

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۵۵ است، در باند C (شواهد محدود) برای سؤال از نوع THERAPY.
sources.interpretation_fa: این systematic review پروتکل ثبت‌شده در PROSPERO، جستجوی چهار پایگاه و ارزیابی risk of bias با ROBINS-I دارد، اما publication bias را بررسی نکرده است. پایه‌ی آن پنج مطالعه‌ی غیرتصادفی با heterogeneity بالاست. ارزش عملی‌اش این است که شواهد فعلی برتری اقتصادی روشنی برای digital workflow در دنچر کامل نشان نمی‌دهد و تجربه‌ی اپراتور بر هزینه‌ی کلینیکی و تعداد جلسات اثر دارد.
